species.real: Striated caracaras are falcons, and on the Falklands they have solved puzzle boxes as quickly as some famously clever parrots.
species.name: Johnny Rook

dex.text: Orange of face, bold of eye, quick with the zip on your rucksack. It has a plan for your sandwich and you have no plan at all.
dex.fact: The striated caracara, called the Johnny rook in the Falklands, is a bold, curious bird of prey that investigates and steals from visitors; it is found in few places beyond the southern tip of South America.
